title: Signing a Whole Membership and Patronage Equity Account Over to the Transferee Named on a Registered Instruction
content:
When a member signs a whole equity membership held under Membership and Patronage Equity over to the transferee named on a registered instruction, what moves is the equity standing on that membership at the moment the transfer is recorded, worked out from the equity account itself rather than from the balance last printed on a statement.

The equity signed over is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the capital retain owed for the year most recently allocated.

Before the equity signed over is worked out, the allocation standing for the year most recently allocated must be the allocation that year's own volume earns.

The observable effect is that the member's own equity account is closed and what moved is recorded on it: the membership is put into transferred standing, dated today, with the equity standing at that moment written onto it, and the registered instruction is marked completed. From then on the account is closed to further allocation and the transferee holds the equity in the member's place. The member sees a closing equity statement showing the amount signed over.

## Making the entry

The entry is made with `transfer_membership_equity_359bd53a`, which is the member's own tool: it is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, as the member's own act of signing the membership over. One call closes the account and records what moved.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `membership_id` | the internal reference number of the equity membership being signed over | an identifier, as returned by the equity membership lookup |
| `request_id` | the internal reference number of the registered transfer instruction the member signed | an identifier, as returned by the equity request lookup |
| `equity_standing_amount` | the equity standing on the membership at the moment it is signed over | USD to 2 decimal places, half a cent rounding up, never negative |

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence naming the membership closed, the equity recorded as signed over, the date the transfer took effect and the instruction it was recorded against. The sentence appearing at all is what indicates the transfer was recorded; a failure raises instead of returning.
